nodes.name: ordelo_post
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL helper function that performs HTTP POST requests to URLs constructed from ordelo_config entries, acting as a reusable wrapper over the pg_net/http_post extension for calling FastAPI webhook endpoints from SQL.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the pg_net/http extension (http_post) and reads base URLs from the ordelo_config table by config_key, enabling database-driven endpoint routing.

nodes.name: process_delivery
nodes.summary: Core pg_cron scheduled function (every 5 seconds) that drives delivery status transitions by inserting the next eligible vehicle-type delivery_detail row when prior ones time out, and marking delivery_summary as 'timedout' when all vehicle types are exhausted, using restaurant-specific or global timeout config from ordelo_config.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses CTEs chained with UNION ALL to atomically compute vehicle ranking, detect all-timed-out orders, and INSERT next delivery_detail in a single query pass. Timeout is measured from redispatch_dtts when present (re-dispatch support) or dtts otherwise.

nodes.name: process_restaurant_confirmation
nodes.summary: pg_cron scheduled function (every 5 seconds) that times out restaurant confirmations for both delivery_summary and takeaway_summary orders where restaurant_confirmation_status is 'restaurant_unconfirmed' or 'restaurant_accept' and no pickup_time has been set within the configured interval, transitioning them to 'restaurant_timedout' and triggering the delivery_hooks webhook.
nodes.languageNotes: Handles both delivery and takeaway order flows in a single function using UNION ALL over two UPDATE CTEs. Timeout value cascades: restaurant-specific config key, then global key, then 5-minute fallback.

nodes.name: test_reset_order_and_dispatch
nodes.summary: Test utility function that resets a delivery order back to 'restaurant_unconfirmed' status by deleting all associated inflight, dispatch, and detail rows and resetting the delivery_summary, intended for development and QA re-testing of the delivery workflow.

nodes.name: test_reset_takeaway_order
nodes.summary: Test utility function that resets a takeaway order's confirmation status back to 'restaurant_unconfirmed' in takeaway_summary, enabling QA re-runs of the restaurant confirmation flow for takeaway orders.
